# National Closet Company

> National Closet Company is a family-owned (not a franchise) custom closet and custom cabinet company that designs, builds, and professionally installs custom closet systems, custom cabinets and whole-home storage throughout Middle Tennessee (within ~90 miles of Gallatin, TN). Its mission is beautiful custom-designed closets at a price normal families can afford — the same caliber of materials and craftsmanship the big national brands sell, without franchise royalties, national ad fees, or showroom markup. Offerings range from economy to extravagant. Free in-home design consultation, transparent pricing, and a single team from design through installation.

## Key facts
- Business name: National Closet Company (also "National Closet Co.")
- Parent company: Blair Custom Interiors (https://blaircustominteriors.com) — National Closet Company is a division of Blair Custom Interiors, the family's custom cabinetry and interior remodeling company in Nashville
- Type: Family owned and operated — NOT a franchise (no franchise royalties or brand-name markup)
- Phone / text: 629-298-8241
- Email: hello@nationalclosetco.com
- Website: https://nationalclosetco.com
- Service area: Middle Tennessee — every city within ~90 miles of Gallatin, TN: Gallatin, Hendersonville, Nashville, Goodlettsville, Mount Juliet, Lebanon, Brentwood, Franklin, Murfreesboro, Smyrna, La Vergne, Nolensville, White House, Portland, Belle Meade, Green Hills, Hermitage, Old Hickory, Spring Hill, Columbia, Springfield, Clarksville, Dickson, and Bowling Green KY
- Rating: 5.0 / 5 stars
- Consultation: 100% free, in-home, in-person measuring (no virtual)

## Services (Custom Closets & Custom Cabinets)
- Custom Walk-In Closets
- Reach-In Closet Systems
- Custom Cabinets — kitchen cabinets and islands, bathroom vanities, laundry room and mudroom cabinetry, built-in hutches and bookcases, media walls and entertainment centers, home office cabinetry, garage and utility cabinets (https://nationalclosetco.com/custom-cabinets-nashville)
- Home Offices (built-in desks, cabinetry, shelving)
- Garage Storage Systems (cabinets, slatwall, overhead racks)
- Custom Pantries
- Laundry Rooms & Mudrooms
- Murphy Beds / Wall Beds
- Media Centers & Wall Units
- Accessories: islands, soft-close drawers, glass fronts, LED lighting, shoe shelving, valet rods, pull-out hampers

## How it works (4 steps)
1. Free in-home consultation — we measure your space in person and go over options and finishes.
2. Photorealistic design — see every finish and detail with an exact price on the spot.
3. Precision manufacturing — custom-built in our facility, typically 2–4 weeks.
4. Professional installation — usually completed in a single day.

## Pricing (typical, U.S.)
- Custom reach-in closet system: ~$1,000–$2,500
- Custom walk-in closet: ~$3,000–$10,000+
- National average custom closet: ~$2,000
- Custom cabinets: priced per project (linear footage, door style, finish, interior fittings) — no published range; an exact written price comes with the free in-home design
- Free, no-obligation exact price at the in-home consultation. Every project is paid in three simple installments: 50% at signing, 25% when installation is scheduled, 25% on install day — no interest, no penalty for paying early

## Frequently asked questions
- Are you a franchise? No — 100% family owned and operated, so you pay for craftsmanship, not a brand name.
- How much does a custom closet cost? Typically $1,000–$10,000+, national average ~$2,000.
- Are custom closets worth it? For most homeowners, yes — they often double usable storage and last for years.
- Do custom closets add value to your home? They're a strong selling feature that makes a home more appealing, though they don't change a formal appraisal.
- What materials do you use? Furniture-grade laminate and thermally-fused melamine over engineered wood, in dozens of colors and finishes.
- How long does it take? About 3–6 weeks total; installation is usually one day.
- Do you build more than closets? Yes — custom cabinets (kitchens, baths, laundry, mudrooms, built-ins, media walls), garages, pantries, home offices, laundry/mudrooms, Murphy beds, and media/wall units.
- Do you build custom cabinets? Yes — kitchen cabinets and islands, bathroom vanities, laundry and mudroom cabinetry, built-in hutches and media walls, designed free in your home and installed by our own team. National Closet Company is a division of Blair Custom Interiors, a Nashville custom cabinetry company.
- How much do custom cabinets cost? Priced per project by linear footage, door style, finish and fittings; an exact written price comes with the free in-home design.
- Is there a custom closet company near me? We serve homeowners across Nashville and Middle Tennessee, within about 90 miles of Gallatin, TN — call/text 629-298-8241 to confirm your area.
